Daytona USA (recompiled) - public build
=======================================

A statically recompiled PC build of the Xbox 360 XBLA release of Daytona USA.
No game files are included. You must own the game and supply your own copy.


ADD YOUR GAME
-------------

This is an XBLA title, so there is no disc image. What you need is the LIVE /
STFS content package for Daytona USA, copied off your own Xbox 360 (the file
usually has no extension and a long hexadecimal name; its first four bytes are
the letters LIVE).

With Python 3 installed, from this folder:

    python extract_game.py "<path to your STFS package>" --assets assets --out extracted

That writes assets\default.xex, which is the only file the game needs to start.
The extracted\ folder it also creates is just the unpacked contents of the
package; you can delete it afterwards.

If the extractor reports "is not an Xbox 360 LIVE/STFS package", you have
pointed it at the wrong file - most likely an already-extracted default.xex
rather than the package that contains it.


TO PLAY
-------

Once assets\default.xex exists, double-click daytona.exe. It loads the .\assets
folder next to it, so there is no launcher and no configuration to do first.


REQUIREMENTS
------------

Windows 10/11 x64, a Direct3D 12 capable GPU, and the Microsoft Visual C++
Redistributable (x64):  https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe


SETTINGS AND LOGS
-----------------

Edit daytona.ini next to the exe, then restart - the settings are read at
startup, not live. It covers window size, fullscreen, monitor, vsync, letterbox
and safe area under [Display]; filtering and upscaler under [Graphics]; and log
level under [Diagnostics]. Leave game_resolution at 1280x720 for authentic
output - it is the guest render resolution, not the window size.

Logs are written to logs\daytona_NNN.log next to the exe. If the game fails to
start, that file is the first thing to look at - and the most useful thing to
attach to a bug report.
